name: Agent probe
description: Window check fixture in the place of a process plugin: its sidecar starts a process of the surface that runs `sok context`, and the view reports what the process wrote.

status.name: agentprobe.process
status.description: The last process of the surface: the SOKSAK_CONFIG_DIR that it carried and the exit status, the signal, the standard output and the standard error of the `sok context` that it ran, or the error of the sidecar; null before the first process ended.

commands.name: agentprobe.start
commands.description: Asks the sidecar to start for the surface a process that runs `<sok> context`, where sok is the path of a sok program.
